prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity north-star composition for a native Android phone app, portrait 9:16, revised hybrid option B
Primary request: Create a very simple Material 3 Pharma Auto invoice editor for non-technical pharmacy staff. Keep the invoice-review header and compact neighboring line context from reference image 1. Directly below the selected line, place a simple expiry-split selector with two large tabs: "Expiry 1 · 2 boxes" selected and "Expiry 2 · 1 box", plus a clearly labeled "Add expiry" action. The selected expiry editor starts with one row containing editable Quantity and Expiry date fields. Below it, show the four commercial values in the two-column OCR Source versus Confirmed format from reference image 2. Include a plain "Use these prices for all expiry rows" checkbox so users understand whether split prices are shared; an individual split can be edited independently.
Structure: top app bar 7%; invoice summary and two compact neighboring line rows 18%; selected-line identity and expiry selector 16%; selected expiry quantity/date editor 12%; four source-versus-confirmed commercial rows 36%; collapsed expandable invoice totals and save footer 11%. Footer shows "Invoice total EGP 171.00" and "Review & save", with a chevron indicating expansion. Remove policy cards and policy prose.
Style: conventional Material 3 light theme, white and pale cool gray, deep forest green primary, very pale green confirmed column, amber only for uncertain OCR, Android system typography, 48dp targets, minimal surfaces, modest 8-12dp corners, thin dividers, direct plain language.
Exact visible labels: "Pharma Auto", "Invoice review", "3 of 8 lines checked", "Line 1", "Item 60495", "Expiry rows", "Expiry 1 · 2 boxes", "Expiry 2 · 1 box", "Add expiry", "Quantity", "Expiry date", "2 boxes", "30 Jun 2028", "OCR source", "Confirmed", "Purchase unit price", "Discount 1", "Discount 2", "Selling price per box", "Use these prices for all expiry rows", "Invoice total EGP 171.00", "Review & save".
Constraints: exactly four commercial rows; each expiry has its own quantity; selected expiry can override prices; preserve neighboring line context; footer is expandable; simple enough for non-technical staff; no keyboard; no device frame; no policy summary or policy prose, no global repricing language, no Genius commit claim, no medicine name, supplier/customer, testimonial, or watermark.
Avoid: excessive cards, decorative pills, dense spreadsheet, gradients, glassmorphism, icon-only destructive actions, floating modal sheets, pharmacy cross.
